description: Create a .tres resource file from an engine Resource class or a GDScript resource script (class_name or path), with property values set. Values are checked against declared types as in set_node_properties (Property Values in docs/tools.md). Refuses an existing file unless overwrite is true. Returns: resourcePath, resourceType, scriptPath and properties read back from the saved file. Errors on an unknown type or property, and while a runtime session is live on this project.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at resourcePath (default: false).

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

properties.description: Property values to set, keyed by property name as written, with the same value rules as set_node_properties. script and resource_path are refused.

resourcePath.description: Path of the .tres file inside the project, e.g. "items/sword.tres". Created with its folders.

type.description: Engine Resource class such as "StyleBoxFlat", a registered class_name, or a GDScript path such as "items/item_stats.gd". A class_name is known only after the editor or an import has scanned the project.

name: create_resource

properties.description: Each property the call set, read back from the saved file, in the shapes set_node_properties accepts.

resourcePath.description: Project-relative path of the .tres file written.

resourceType.description: Engine class of the saved resource (Resource for a script class).

scriptPath.description: Project-relative path of its script, or null.
